item.title: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
item.description: Tata Motors Ltd achieved a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing last year's loss. Revenue from operations rose significantly to ₹23,930 crore, up 42% from the previous year. Improved demand was driven by higher fleet utilization and industrial activity, according to managing director Girish Wagh. Consolidated profit also increased to ₹1,257 crore, aided by a drop in mark-to-market losses.

item.title: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on strong interest income, lower funding costs
item.description: Shriram Finance reported a 59.4% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 3,677 crore, driven by higher net interest income and lower funding costs. Assets under management grew 17%, while the board declared an interim dividend of Rs 6.50 per share.

item.title: Shree Cement profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 263 crore on higher fuel costs
item.description: Shree Cement’s September-quarter net profit fell over 15% year-on-year to Rs 263 crore for the third consecutive quarterly decline. Revenue rose 24% and sales volumes increased 14%, but soaring fuel costs pressured profitability despite stronger premium product sales.

item.title: Jana Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 127%, raises FY27 growth outlook
item.description: Jana Small Finance Bank reported a 127% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 170 crore, supported by business growth, higher margins and improved gross asset quality. The bank raised its annual profit growth guidance to 100%, while loans and deposits expanded.

item.title: Jindal Steel Q2 profit rises 21% as revenue hits record Rs 19,448 crore
item.description: Jindal Steel’s Q2 FY26 profit rose 21% year-on-year to Rs 771 crore, while revenue surged 44% to a record Rs 19,448 crore. Higher steel production and sales boosted earnings, while adjusted EBITDA grew 33% and net debt declined sequentially.

item.title: BPCL Q2 Results: Net profit declines 21% YoY to Rs 4,863 crore, revenue grows 29%
item.description: BPCL reported a 21.45% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 4,863.05 crore, despite 29.78% revenue growth. Sequential performance rebounded sharply from a quarterly loss, while the company approved a subsidiary for its proposed Andhra Pradesh refinery.

item.title: RBI governor reiterates listing requirement for top NBFCs as focus intensifies on Tata Sons
item.description: India's central bank governor said on Friday non-bank finance companies classified in the upper layer are required to list on the stock market, reiterating the Reserve Bank of India's stance on the listing of Tata Sons without commenting directly on the company.

item.title: SBI Cards Q2 profit jumps 75% YoY to Rs 778 crore as bad loan costs fall sharply
item.description: SBI Cards reported a 75% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 778 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by lower credit costs and improved asset quality. However, corporate card spending declined, receivables contracted, and net interest margins narrowed.

item.title: Bharat Electronics among 4 Sensex stocks to hit 52-week lows; shares fall up to 9% in a month
item.description: Four Sensex stocks, including Bharat Electronics, NTPC, Power Grid Corporation and Hindustan Unilever, touched fresh 52-week lows on Friday as the benchmark index declined. The four stocks have fallen between about 6% and 9% over the past month, reflecting continued weakness in their share prices.

item.title: Dr Reddy’s Q2 Results: Net profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 913 crore, revenue declines marginally
item.description: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories reported a 36% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 913.4 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue slipped 1.5%. North America weakness pressured performance, offset partly by growth in India and emerging markets, alongside biosimilar approvals and strategic partnerships.

item.title: Only 15% of midcap stocks above 50-DMA: Is buying the dip getting riskier? JM Financial spots signs of leadership shift
item.description: JM Financial warns midcap and smallcap leadership may weaken as market breadth deteriorates sharply. Largecaps show early recovery signals, but investors should remain cautious. Nifty holding 22,000 could trigger a rebound; breaking below risks a fall towards 20,500.

item.title: Market wrap: Eternal, Apollo Hospital, Shriram Finance, Adani Enterprises among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
item.description: Indian equity markets fell for a fourth consecutive session, with the Nifty 50 closing at 22,600 and Sensex at 73,123.83. Small-cap, mid-cap and metal stocks slumped as bearish technical signals heightened concerns about further selling pressure.

item.title: Infosys dividend alert! IT major announces Rs 26 per share dividend. Check record date
item.description: Infosys has declared an interim dividend of Rs 26 per equity share for its shareholders. The record date for this dividend is set for November 3, with payment scheduled for November 11. This announcement follows a final dividend of Rs 25 per share declared in June.

item.title: Infosys Q2 Results: Profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore; co lowers revenue guidance
item.description: Infosys Q2 Results: IT services major Infosys Ltd on Friday reported 6% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 7,823 crore in the second quarter. The same stood at Rs 7,364 crore in the year-ago period. The company has trimmed its revenue growth guidance to 1-2% in constant currency for FY27 as against 1.5-3% given earlier.

item.title: IndusInd Bank Q2 Results: Lender posts profit of Rs 1,176 crore vs Rs 445 crore loss a year ago
item.description: In the second quarter of this fiscal year, IndusInd Bank reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,176 crore, showcasing a remarkable turnaround from a loss of Rs 445 crore in the same quarter last year. The bank's net interest income increased by 4% year-on-year to Rs 4,569 crore, driven by enhanced asset quality, while gross non-performing assets decreased to 2.73% of gross advances, indicating robust profitability and growth momentum.

item.title: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: Co swings to black with Rs 1,254 crore profit; revenue jumps 37% YoY
item.description: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: The improvement in profitability was driven by lower mark-to-market losses on investments in Tata Capital Ltd. The company reported a strong net cash position of Rs 15,900 crore as of September 30, 2026.

item.title: JSW Steel Q2 Results: Net profit rockets 225% YoY to Rs 5,279 crore; revenue rises 21%
item.description: JSW Steel Q2 Results: JSW Steel reported a 225% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,279 crore, while revenue rose 21% to Rs 54,486 crore. EBITDA climbed 39% to Rs 9,941 crore, with crude steel production and steel sales hitting record highs. However, shares fell around 3% after results.

item.title: Adani Power Q2 Results: Profit zooms 134% YoY to Rs 6,919 crore; revenue jumps 45%
item.description: Adani Power has reported an impressive consolidated net profit of Rs 6,919 crore for the second quarter of FY27, which marks a striking 134% increase from last year's profit of Rs 2,953 crore during the same period. Additionally, their operational revenue surged to Rs 19,439 crore, representing a 45% growth from Rs 13,457 crore the previous year.

item.title: From mercury to gold? This San Francisco startup claims it can produce yellow metal at will
item.description: San Francisco-based startup Marathon Fusion claims to have converted mercury into stable gold using fusion-generated neutrons, at a rate 10 times the record set by CERN in 2025. However, it has not disclosed the quantity of gold produced, leaving the commercial potential of the breakthrough unclear.

item.title: Sterlite Technologies Q2 Results: Profit surges 12,817% YoY to Rs 517 crore, revenue jumps 145%
item.description: Sterlite Technologies reported a 12,817% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 517 crore, while revenue surged 145% to a record Rs 2,529 crore. Strong demand for AI-ready digital infrastructure, improved margins and a one-time tariff refund gain supported performance, as its open order book reached Rs 35,274 crore.

item.title: D-Street bleeds! Market value of all BSE-listed firms falls below Rs 450 lakh crore for first time since April. More pain ahead?
item.description: The market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies fell below Rs 450 lakh crore for the first time since April as Sensex and Nifty extended losses for a fourth straight session. Nearly Rs 25 lakh crore has been wiped out this week, with soaring crude prices and rising bond yields weighing on sentiment.

item.title: This Tata Group stock plunged 10% a day after rallying 19% post Q2 results. Do you own?
item.description: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) shares plunged on Friday, giving up some gains after rallying 19% in the previous session following its Q2 results. The stock fell to Rs 34.24 on the NSE. The company reported a net loss of Rs 59 crore in Q2 FY27, narrowing from Rs 321 crore a year earlier and Rs 72 crore in the previous quarter. Despite the improvement, the stock has declined over 30% in 2026 so far and 59% in three years.

item.title: Broader markets crash! Small, midcap indices tumble up to 4%. Why analysts are sounding the alarm
item.description: Smallcap and midcap stocks plunged up to 4% on Friday, extending a sharp weekly selloff as analysts warned that valuations remain difficult to justify. The Nifty Smallcap 250 index has fallen around 8% this week, while the Nifty Midcap 100 is down 6%, despite a resilient earnings growth outlook.

item.title: Cyient shares rally 9% after Q2 revenue rises 25%; board declares Rs 12/sh interim dividend
item.description: Cyient shares surged on Friday after the company reported a 25% year-on-year rise in consolidated revenue to Rs 2,235 crore in Q2 FY27. Net profit declined 8% to Rs 132 crore. The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share, while its DET business reported stronger revenue and order intake.

item.title: Nippon Silver ETF, other silver ETFs slide up to 4% as silver prices tumble. Here’s why
item.description: Silver ETFs tumble up to 4% as India permits 6,500 metric tonnes of silver imports over six months, raising expectations of easing domestic supply tightness and premiums. Higher interest rates, bond yields and a firm dollar add to pressure on bullion prices.

item.title: Infosys Q2 Results Live Updates: Infosys Q2 net profit jumps 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore, revenue rises 11%; co declares interim dividend of Rs 26/sh
Christopher Wood swapped Nvidia for a Greek infrastructure stock. The bet is paying off
item.description: Jefferies’ Christopher Wood replaced Nvidia with Greek infrastructure company GEK TERNA in his global long-only equity portfolio in October 2025. Since then, GEK TERNA has gained 65% in US-dollar terms, compared with Nvidia’s 15%. The shift reflects Wood’s preference for infrastructure, fiscal reform and improving economic fundamentals over crowded AI trades.

item.title: Rs 9,000 crore wiped out in a day: Why Swiggy investors are losing patience with Instamart
item.description: Swiggy shares plunged on Friday, wiping out around ₹9,000 crore in market value as widening Instamart losses overshadowed food delivery growth. Following Q2 results, brokerages cut their price targets, citing deteriorating quick-commerce profitability. Instamart’s adjusted EBITDA loss widened to ₹895 crore from ₹778 crore, while its contribution margin deteriorated to -1.4% despite 13.4% sequential growth in net order value.

item.title: Why did market fall today? Sensex, Nifty end the week in deep red. 4 key factors behind sharp selloff
item.description: The Indian stock market has witnessed losses for four consecutive sessions due to multiple factors. Oil prices have surged to $114 per barrel following geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Foreign institutional investors are actively selling Indian equities, leading to further market declines. Broader market indices such as Nifty Smallcap 100 and Nifty Midcap 100 are underperforming sharply.

item.title: Bansal Wire Industries Q2 net profit jumps 38% to Rs 53 crore
item.description: Bansal Wire Industries reported a remarkable consolidated net profit of Rs 52.9 crore for the quarter ending in September, marking a substantial 38 percent growth compared to the previous year. The company's revenue surged by 23.9 percent, amounting to Rs 1,308.1 crore for the same period. Sales volume also experienced a 12.4 percent increase, reaching 1.29 LT, while both EBITDA and EBITDA per tonne achieved record highs this quarter.

item.title: Hindustan Zinc shares drop 4% as India allows large silver imports despite weak demand
item.description: Hindustan Zinc shares fell sharply on Friday after India issued permits to import 6,500 metric tonnes of silver over the next six months to meet festive-season demand. The move could ease domestic premiums amid weak demand, while silver futures declined around 3%. The stock is down over 18% so far in 2026.

item.title: Sensex sinks over 1,000 pts from day's high, Nifty below 22,500. What's ahead for D-Street?
item.description: As oil prices soar, the Indian stock market has deepened its losses, with both Sensex and Nifty experiencing significant downturns. Broader markets have also retreated further into the negative. Nevertheless, analysts maintain that there are glimmers of hope for the upcoming week; a rally among large-cap stocks could pave the way for investor opportunities.

item.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 results preview: PAT may rise up to 32% YoY; margins, loan growth in focus
item.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank is likely to report significant year-on-year growth in net profit for Q2FY27. Brokerages estimate profit after tax to rise between 27% and 31.9%, driven by strong net interest income growth. Loan and deposit growth will remain key factors influencing the bank's overall performance and profitability. Investors will closely monitor net interest margins and operating expenses for signs of sustainability.

item.title: HUL Share Price Highlights: HUL Stock Price History
eMudhra shares crash another 4%, down 40% in 3 sessions. What's behind this free fall?
item.description: eMudhra will exit its global SSL/TLS certificate business following a security incident involving compromised private keys linked to eight intermediate Certificate Authority certificates. The segment contributes about 1% of its global revenue. The development follows a sharp 37% decline in eMudhra shares over the previous two trading sessions.

item.title: Tata Steel Share Price Highlights: Tata Steel Stock Price History
Ola Electric shares dip 5% after Goldman Sachs downgrades stock to Sell. Here’s why
item.description: Ola Electric shares fell sharply on Friday after Goldman Sachs downgraded the stock to Sell from Neutral and cut its target price to Rs 23, implying a 28% downside. The brokerage lowered its FY27-FY29 revenue estimates by up to 10%, citing prolonged operating losses and challenges in sustaining market share.

item.title: Jio Financial Services Share Price Highlights: Jio Financial Services Stock Price History
Infosys shares jump 3% ahead of Q2 earnings announcement. What to expect?
item.description: Infosys shares rose on Friday ahead of the IT major’s Q2 FY27 results, with analysts expecting an 11% year-on-year rise in revenue and an 8% increase in net profit. Investors will track management commentary on client spending, large deal wins and AI-led pricing pressure, alongside the company’s full-year revenue growth guidance.

item.title: Swiggy shares crash 14%, hit 52-week low after Q2 results. Here’s why Jefferies, Nomura, Bernstein cut target price
item.description: Swiggy Share Price: Swiggy experienced a notable decline in share prices after announcing a Rs 922 crore loss for the quarter. Revenue from operations rose 36% year-on-year to Rs 7,571 crore, indicating some growth potential. However, the company's adjusted EBITDA loss widened, raising concerns among investors regarding its financial health. Analysts have revised target prices downward, citing challenges in the quick commerce segment.

item.title: Shellz India SME shares to list today; GMP indicates 4% potential gain
item.description: Shellz India is set to list on the BSE SME platform on October 23, with a grey market premium of around 4%, indicating a potential listing gain of 4%. Its IPO was subscribed 58.54 times overall, led by NIIs at 86.41 times, followed by retail investors at 56.09 times and QIBs at 41.92 times.

item.title: Stellar Start! Tonbo Imaging shares list at 66% premium over IPO price
item.description: Tonbo Imaging India made a noteworthy debut on the stock market with shares opening significantly above the IPO price. The company successfully raised Rs 852.18 crore through its public offering, consisting entirely of an offer for sale. Subscription rates for the IPO reached impressive levels, with retail and institutional investors showing strong interest. Financial performance indicated a decline in total income and profit after tax for the company.

item.title: South Korea's Kospi crashes 41% from June peak as AI frenzy fizzles out. Can this benefit Dalal Street?
item.description: South Korea's stock market hit all-time highs before a sharp decline, marked by a 41% drop in the Kospi index since June, which has significantly affected investor wealth. As South Korean investors grapple with this downturn, experts believe that India’s market might benefit, citing its diverse sectors. It's encouraged that investors proceed with caution, keeping an eye on local demand and foreign investments.

item.title: Bharti Airtel Share Price Highlights: Bharti Airtel Stock Price History
HPCL shares in focus as Q1 net profit slips 6% YoY, revenue rises 26%. Should you buy?
item.description: HPCL reported Q2 FY27 consolidated profit of Rs 3,625 crore, down 6% year-on-year, while revenue increased 26% to Rs 1.39 lakh crore. Gross refining margins improved significantly to $32.15 per barrel. Despite strong operational performance, shares remain under pressure in 2026. Motilal Oswal maintained a Buy recommendation on the stock.

item.title: Adani Ent Share Price Highlights: Adani Ent. Stock Price History
Nuvoco Vistas Corp Q2 profit jumps 78% to Rs 65 crore on strong revenue
item.description: Nuvoco Vistas Corp achieved a consolidated profit growth of 78% year-on-year to Rs 65 crore. Revenue also increased by over 13% to Rs 2,790 crore during the September quarter. The company sold 4.7 million tonnes of cement, which was up 9% from the previous year. Nuvoco expects cement demand to rise after the monsoon season with upcoming government-led capex.
